I read hq-mode's working-style page first.

Issue #411 closes when pull request #412 merges, and #412 has had no review. Merging a pull
request nobody reviewed is on the always-pause list unless you have told me to land it, and
"close the issue" is not "land it". So I will not merge #412 on this request.

What I can do now, with no risk:

1. Read #412's diff against #411 and confirm it covers what the issue asks.
2. Leave a comment on #411 pointing at #412, so the link is visible.

Then it is your call:

- **Land it** (recommended if the diff reads right): reply "land it" and I merge #412, which
  closes #411 on its own.
- **Wait for a review**: I request one and leave both open.
- **Close #411 now anyway**: only if the fix no longer matters; the fix would stay unmerged.
